title: CPF Module Schema: Container App Jobs module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-containerappjobs'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

Setting a value for Host in headers can be used to override this for HTTP and HTTPS type probes. initial_delay = (Optional) The time in seconds to wait after the container has started before the probe is started. interval_seconds = (Optional) How often, in seconds, the probe should run. Defaults to 1. transport = (Required) Type of probe. Possible values are TCP, HTTP, and HTTPS. }) startup_probe = (Optional) object({ failure_count_threshold = (Optional) The number of consecutive failures required to consider this probe as failed. container_app_environment_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Container App Environment within which this Container App should exist. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

container_registry_id.description: (Required) The private container registry for the Container Instances.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment.description: Whether to create the role assignment for this app.

enable_key_vault_role_assignment.description: (Optional) Whether to create the Key Vault Secrets User role assignment.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

Required when trigger_type is set to 'event'. object({ parallelism = (Optional) Number of parallel replicas of a job that can run at a given time. Must be less than or equal to parallelism. scale = (Optional) Configuration for event-based scaling behavior. object({ max_executions = (Optional) Maximum number of job executions that are created for a trigger. min_executions = (Optional) Minimum number of job executions that are created for a trigger. polling_interval_in_seconds = (Optional) Interval to check each event source in seconds. rules = (Optional) Configuration for the event trigger rules. object({ name = (Optional) Name of the rule for identification purposes. custom_rule_type = (Optional) The type of custom rule to use (e.g., "azure-storage-queue", "azure-service-bus", etc.). identity = (Optional) The identity to use for accessing the event source. This can either be the Resource ID of a User Assigned Identity, or System for the System Assigned Identity. metadata = (Optional) A map of key-value pairs containing configuration for the custom rule (e.g., queue name, topic name). authentication = (Optional) Authentication configuration for the event source. object({ secret_name = (Optional) Reference to a secret containing authentication credentials. trigger_parameter = (Optional) The parameter to use for passing the authentication information. }) }) }) })

secret.description: (Optional) Note: Secrets cannot be removed from the service once added, attempting to do so will result in an error. Their values may be zeroed, i.e. set to "", but the named secret must persist. This is due to a technical limitation on the service which causes the service to become unmanageable. map(object({ name = (Required) The Secret name. identity = (Optional) The identity to use for accessing the Key Vault secret reference. This can either be the Resource ID of a User Assigned Identity, or System for the System Assigned Identity. Identity must be used together with key_vault_secret_id key_vault_secret_id = (Optional) The ID of a Key Vault secret. This can be a versioned or version-less ID. }))

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

trigger_type.description: (Required) The type of trigger to use for the Container App Job. Valid options are: - 'manual': Job is triggered manually through user intervention or API call - 'event': Job is triggered in response to specific events (requires event_trigger_config) - 'schedule': Job is triggered on a time-based schedule defined by a cron expression (requires schedule_trigger_config)

uai_principal_id.description: (Required) Principal id of the User Assigned Identity which should be used to access the images from container registry. This identity will be granted `AcrPull` role on the Container Registry.

volume.type: map(object({ name = optional(string) storage_name = optional(string) storage_type = optional(string, "EmptyDir") }))

workload_profile_name.description: (Optional) The name of the Workload Profile in the Container App Environment to place this Container App. Omit this value to use the default Consumption Workload Profile. The possible values could be the name of the workload_profile used in 'azurerm_container_app_environment'.
